name: Spider Climb

header.Components: V, S, M (a drop of bitumen and a spider)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a drop of bitumen and a spider

authored_intent: Touch willing creature; climbing across vertical/ceiling surfaces without hands; climb Speed equals Speed for Concentration; higher slots add creatures; source ending can cause fall.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.
The target also gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
